P2 (design gate advice): both ends of a number question valid integers but min >= max. Behaviour built (it is the sketch behaviour: the caller passes both ends whenever both are valid integers): the question own line at questions[i].max ('Число min должно быть меньше max...') stays, and each chips item is checked against the inverted range, so min 10, max 5, chips [7, 3] gives that own line plus E_LIMIT at chips[0] and chips[1] with the text 'Число 7 вне границ от 10 до 5.' (re-run by me on the built code, the shape rule holds: no word null, within 18 words). The tests step should pin exactly this, or ask the designer to say that the chips range is skipped when min >= max (then one line of validate.js changes).

P3 (design gate advice): an end of the chips range is valid when ctx.int accepts it (Number.isSafeInteger); validate.js passes null for an end that is not valid (minOk / maxOk of the question own check), and checkChips additionally tests Number.isSafeInteger on both ends before using them, so a direct caller (REQ-073) who passes a wrong value gets the integer-form check only.

Small choices inside the design where the text is silent (tests step: pin or reject): (a) chips order: 'previous' is the nearest earlier item that passed the integer and range check, including an item that itself got E_DUP or E_ORDER (same rule as desks in 5.6); (b) an object with an id outside the catalogue: D9 says its parameters are checked for form only, I used level = integer 1-4 (the widest range of the catalogue) with M21 text, tag and glyph by their usual rules, and no parameter is reported as not allowed; (c) the staff-name character class is tested on the untrimmed value (a tab or a no-break space at an end is E_FIELD M14; a name of ordinary spaces only is E_LIMIT because ctx.line trims first); (d) the context of validate.js got one more key, mode ('/1', '/2' or '/3'), used by checkQuestion, checkOption, checkLeads and checkContactFields instead of a new argument on each call (internal, not exported).

Public data (7): publicLook and the two calls lookOfView / ownLookOfView are exported from public-data.js as designed; the questionnaire is /3 when the view has its own look (key order of 7.1); desk, chips and the option object are copied wherever the view has them (by presence, D5), whatsapp is added to leads only for a view that has a look (string or null); max_per_hour and max_stored are never copied. public-data.js reaches fallbackLook through limits.js (limits.js re-exports it with the other names of the shared module: D2 says the core takes names of public/ there).
